claimLedger.claim: Defines PGP/SPD; not harmful to baby; lists aggravating tasks; midwife/GP contact if mobility hard; physio referral; coping tips including pillow between legs and knees together for car transfers; affects up to 1 in 5.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Pelvic pain in pregnancy · Page last reviewed: 12 December 2022
claimLedger.limitations: UK public guidance; Indian maternity pathways and equipment access may differ.

claimLedger.claim: PGP affects 1 in 5; not harmful to baby; early physio; pacing and position advice; most can have vaginal birth; caesarean not normally for PGP; ~1 in 10 ongoing after birth; clot risk if mobility very limited.
claimLedger.sourceSection: RCOG · Pelvic girdle pain and pregnancy · Published: June 2015
claimLedger.limitations: Older patient leaflet; still widely cited—confirm local obstetric advice for induction/caesarean decisions.
